description: After some amount of introspection, I can only conclude that this is the afterlife, or some entryway to the afterlife... or a really cool club in the Meatpacking district after-hours. This is the most genuinely relaxing piece of the Ossuary suite... still has a bit of an edge.
title: Ossuary 5 - Rest
